title: Additivity of a push-forward map that is linear on integer multiplicity currents with compact supports in O (step 4 of the parent)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, O ⊆ ℝ^P any set, and push : 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) → 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) any map (𝒟_n(ℝ^P) = GeometricCurrentOn univ n) such that push(X₁ − X₂) = push X₁ − push X₂ for all integer multiplicity X₁, X₂ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (contract IsIntegerMultiplicity) whose supports spt X₁, spt X₂ (GeometricCurrentOn.support, Simon 6.2.11) are compact and contained in O; here − is the contract's difference of currents, (X₁ − X₂)(ω) = X₁(ω) − X₂(ω). Let X, Y ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity with spt X and spt Y compact and contained in O. Then there is an integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) such that S(ω) = X(ω) + Y(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P), spt S ⊆ spt X ∪ spt Y, spt S is compact, and push S(ω) = push X(ω) + push Y(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclid P)) (push : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ X₁ X₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity X₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity X₂ → IsCompact X₁.support → X₁.support ⊆ O → IsCompact X₂.support → X₂.support ⊆ O → push (X₁ - X₂) = push X₁ - push X₂) → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → IsCompact X.support → X.support ⊆ O → IsCompact Y.support → Y.support ⊆ O → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, S ω = X ω + Y ω) ∧ S.support ⊆ X.support ∪ Y.support ∧ IsCompact S.support ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, push S ω = push X ω + push Y ω
